title: VisualModel
description: Defines visual properties and appearance for entities.
content:
VisualModel

Defines visual properties and appearance for entities.

Model

Schema

JSON
{
  "sprite": "sprites/player_idle",
  "scale": 1.0,
  "flipX": false,
  "flipY": false,
  "color": "#FFFFFF",
  "opacity": 1.0
}

Description

The VisualModel defines how an entity appears visually in the game world. It controls the sprite used for rendering, the scale factor applied to the visual, horizontal and vertical flipping, tint color, and opacity. This model is commonly referenced by other models such as WeaponModel to define the visual representation of game objects.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
spritestringThe sprite name or path used for rendering the entity.
scalefloatThe visual scale factor applied to the sprite. Default is 1.0.
flipXboolWhether to flip the sprite horizontally. Default is false.
flipYboolWhether to flip the sprite vertically. Default is false.
colorstringThe tint color applied to the sprite, as a hex color string. Default is #FFFFFF (no tint).
opacityfloatThe opacity of the sprite, ranging from 0 (fully transparent) to 1 (fully opaque). Default is 1.0.

Example

JSON
{
  "sprite": "sprites/enemies/slime_green",
  "scale": 1.5,
  "flipX": false,
  "flipY": false,
  "color": "#80FF80",
  "opacity": 0.9
}

Related

  • WeaponModel — Uses VisualModel for weapon appearance
  • ProjectileModel — Projectiles often reference visual properties
  • ParticleSpawnModel — Particle effects for visual feedback
